name: Interface Translation Auto
description: Batch-translate untranslated interface strings via DeepL.
project_description:
Translates untranslated interface strings in batch using the DeepL API or OpenAI API.

 This module adds a "Translate untranslated strings" link on the Languages page

and runs a batch to translate all missing interface strings from English to the

selected language.

 Usage 
 - Add API key for DeepL or OpenAI on settings page: /admin/config/regional/interface-translation-auto

- Go on Languages page: /admin/config/regional/language

- Click on link 'Translate untranslated strings' and wait when batch proccess will be finished.
